kind: Griffiths-nonpositive and split scalar Hopf complement index review
scope: Pairwise Griffiths-nonpositive Hermitian curvature gives least index n+r. A closed submanifold with least index kappa bounds the ambient index below by kappa using the exact dimension loss. Split scalar Hopf bundles have least r+1 when all parameters contract and n+r when all are noncontracting; mixed rank t gives max(r+1,n+t)<=kappa<=n+r only.

analytic_review_obligations.scope: Connected compact base n>=1, positive rank r, line projectivization and smooth exhaustion convexity are unchanged from517.
analytic_review_obligations.curvature-sign: The retained convention has horizontal Levi G equal to minus the curvature pairing, not plus it.
analytic_review_obligations.Chern-normal-frame: At any base point a holomorphic unitary first-jet-normal frame gives zero first metric derivatives and zero mixed Hessian block.
analytic_review_obligations.squared-norm-Hessian: LG(u,w)=-h(R(u,ubar)v,v)+|w|h^2 in that frame, so pairwise nonpositive curvature makes the full total-space Hessian semipositive.
analytic_review_obligations.homogeneous-input: The smooth Hermitian squared norm is global, positive off zero and homogeneous under every complex scalar;517 applies at its exact scope.
analytic_review_obligations.mean-boundary: Nonpositive trace does not imply pairwise nonpositive curvature; diag(1,-2) illustrates this local algebra gap only.
analytic_review_obligations.restriction-indices: The contradiction only uses1<=p<kappa<=D<=N, so D-p+1 is a valid positive count.
analytic_review_obligations.closed-properness: A restricted sublevel is a closed subset of a compact full sublevel; closedness of Z is essential.
analytic_review_obligations.compact-exception: The restricted exception K intersect Z is compact and all points outside it satisfy the full positive-count hypothesis.
analytic_review_obligations.positive-plane: A Hermitian form with N-p+1 positive eigenvalues has a complex positive subspace P of that dimension.
analytic_review_obligations.intersection-count: dim(P intersect TZ)>=dimP+D-N=D-p+1; this precise loss, not unrestricted preservation of all positives, controls restriction.
analytic_review_obligations.restricted-Levi: Holomorphic inclusion pulls back the Levi form of the smooth function to the intrinsic Levi form of its restriction.
analytic_review_obligations.restriction-conclusion: The restricted exhaustion would be p-convex contrary to its least index kappa; kappa=1 leaves no smaller p to exclude.
analytic_review_obligations.Hopf-action: The real scalar contraction0<q<1, n>=2, nonzero complex parameters and rankr>=1 give the stated direct-sum quotient.
analytic_review_obligations.all-deck-iterates: Each q^(2bj)|aj|^2=1 yields invariance for every positive and negative integer deck power and includes arbitrary phases.
analytic_review_obligations.metric-positivity: All diagonal coefficients |z|^(2bj) are smooth positive for z!=0; G is positive for every nonzero total fibre vector.
analytic_review_obligations.curvature-direct-sum: The diagonal connection yields the weighted sum of the line curvatures; the factor i/(2pi) matches alpha=ddc log|z|^2.
analytic_review_obligations.sign-bj: Because logq<0, bj has the sign of log|aj|; contracting parameters give bj<0, noncontracting give bj>=0.
analytic_review_obligations.contracting-positive-count: With all bj<0 and at least one vj nonzero, the weighted coefficient is strictly positive; alpha has n-1 positive directions.
analytic_review_obligations.contracting-upper: Total dimension n+r and s=n-1 give index n+r-(n-1)=r+1 by the retained reciprocal-norm theorem.
analytic_review_obligations.elliptic-fibres: The projection to projective space has compact embedded elliptic fibres of base dimension1.
analytic_review_obligations.elliptic-flatness: Each log coefficient on a lifted fibre is bj log|zeta|^2 plus a constant, so its Chern curvature vanishes; the direct sum remains unitary flat.
analytic_review_obligations.elliptic-closed-inclusion: The projective complement over the compact closed fibre is the inverse image of that fibre and is closed in the full complement.
analytic_review_obligations.elliptic-lower: The restricted total dimension1+r and517flat result give least indexr+1; the restriction lemma gives this lower bound in every branch.
analytic_review_obligations.noncontracting-psh-off-coordinate-zero: For bj>=0 and vj!=0, the retained log/exponential proof gives actual psh of |z|^(2bj)|vj|^2 on the full local total space.
analytic_review_obligations.individual-coordinate-zero: The same summand is smooth at vj=0 since z!=0; its continuous Hermitian Hessian is the limit of semipositive Hessians there.
analytic_review_obligations.noncontracting-sum: Finite sums of these smooth psh summands are psh, deck invariant and positive off the total zero section;517 gives exact n+r.
analytic_review_obligations.unit-modulus-boundary: bj=0 is allowed with nontrivial phase, including allunitary-flat direct sums; no strict inequality is silently used.
analytic_review_obligations.mixed-rank: 0<t<r ensures the noncontracting subbundle has positive rank and is proper; t=0 is never used for a nonexistent n-dimensional complement.
analytic_review_obligations.mixed-closed-subbundle: The split inclusion O plus F0 into O plus F gives a closed projective subbundle; its intersection with UF is exactly UF0.
analytic_review_obligations.mixed-lower: The pure noncontracting branch for F0 has base dimensionn, rankt and leastn+t; the closed restriction lemma and elliptic restriction yield the maximum lower bound.
analytic_review_obligations.mixed-upper: The universal s=0 upper bound gives n+r and guarantees a least index; the recorded gap does not assert equality.
analytic_review_obligations.rank-one-consistency: For r=1 the pure cases reproduce index2 andn+1 at517, and the mixed case is empty.
analytic_review_obligations.no-generalization: No mixed exact index, nonsplit classification, external tensor or tangent least index, q-completeness, novelty or original-problem closure is proved.
